title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Behavioral and Sustainable Finance
text:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Behavioral and Sustainable Finance
 
Our goal: A central objective of the project is to design and implement field experiments that measure how investors perceive and evaluate the financial and non-financial consequences of sustainable investments, and how these beliefs and preferences influence their investment decisions, with implications for financial institutions, such as pension funds.
Your colleagues: You will work under the supervision of Prof. dr. Rob Bauer and Prof. dr. Peiran Jiao on research investigating investors' beliefs and preferences regarding sustainable investments. This position is part of the Department of Finance within the School of Business and Economics. 
 
We are seeking a motivated and talented postdoctoral researcher to join our research team working at the intersection of sustainable finance, behavioral finance, and experimental methods with both lab and field experiments.

Potential research questions include how investors form beliefs about the financial returns and sustainability impact of investments, how they trade off financial and sustainability objectives, how to effectively measure their sustainability preferences, and how information about sustainability affects their beliefs and investment choices.

The project provides an opportunity to conduct rigorous academic research in collaboration with financial institutions, and potentially other financial market participants, with the aim of producing publications in leading international journals in finance and economics.

The position is a standard full-time postdoctoral appointment, with 80% of working time allocated to research and 20% to teaching and student supervision.

What You Do
As a postdoctoral researcher, you will contribute to the development and implementation of research projects on investors' sustainability beliefs, preferences, and investment decisions.

Your responsibilities will include:
Experimental design: Join the development of research questions, experimental treatments, and methods for eliciting investors' beliefs and preferences, with a particular focus on field experiments.
Experimental implementation: Plan, coordinate, and conduct experiments, including developing experimental protocols, programming, and data collection procedures.
Data analysis: Analyze experimental data using appropriate econometric and statistical methods and investigate underlying behavioral mechanisms.
Academic research: Collaborate with the research team on academic papers, contribute to research presentations, and disseminate findings at international conferences.
Research collaboration: Work with academic collaborators and external research partners, contributing to the successful execution of research projects.
Teaching and supervision (0.2 FTE): Contribute to the department's teaching activities, including teaching small-group tutorials and supervising bachelor's and/or master's theses. Teaching assignments will be aligned with the candidate's expertise and the department's educational needs.
You will have opportunities to work on your own research ideas and develop your academic research profile within the broader scope of the project.

What we offer 
At Maastricht University, you’ll work in an international, open, and engaged environment. We offer:
A 24-month contract (1,0 fte).
A gross monthly salary between €3706,00 and €5760,00 (based on full-time employment of 38 hours per week). 8% holiday allowance and an 8.3% year-end bonus.
29 vacation days (based on full-time), four additional days off (Carnival Monday and Tuesday, Good Friday, and Liberation Day), and the possibility to accrue up to 12 extra days through compensation hours.
Flexible working hours, a home office allowance, and the option to work from home.
Freedom and space to shape your work independently and develop your ideas.
A close-knit community of colleagues to collaborate and grow with.
A solid pension plan via ABP, company fitness schemes, and access to various university sports facilities.
An inspiring work environment in the heart of Europe.
About the School of Business and Economics (SBE)
SBE is an international faculty for economics, business, and policy. We combine academic depth with societal engagement. Our education is small-scale and interactive. Our research focuses on themes such as sustainability, inclusion, and digital transformation. Together, we work on impactful solutions for the world of tomorrow.

Interested?
We welcome applications from candidates interested in contributing to research on sustainable investment decisions using experimental methods.

To apply, please submit the following documents:
A curriculum vitae, including a list of publications and working papers.
A motivation letter describing your research interests, relevant experimental experience, and motivation for applying for this position (maximum two pages).
One representative research paper, such as your job market paper or a published or unpublished research article.
Names and contact details of two academic referees.
For further information about the position and research project, please contact:

Prof. dr. Rob Bauer
r.bauer@maastrichtuniversity.nl
Prof. dr. Peiran Jiao
p.jiao@maastrichtuniversity.nl

Application deadline: January 10th 2027
Preferred starting date: September 1st 2027
Applications should be submitted through the official Maastricht University recruitment system and will be reviewed on a rolling basis. We look forward to getting to know you!

About Maastricht University 
At Maastricht University, we collaboratively seek solutions to help move the world forward. We do this with 23,300 students and 5,400 employees across 5 regional locations, 6 faculties, and more than 70 research institutes. We encourage you to push boundaries and discover new opportunities for yourself and the world around you. Together, we can find the answers for tomorrow.

The vacancy is open for internal and external candidates. In case of equal qualifications, internal candidates will be prioritized.

At Maastricht University, we prefer to contact potential candidates directly. We therefore kindly ask that no agencies or intermediaries submit offers or approaches.
Maastricht University is committed to promoting and nurturing a diverse and inclusive community. We believe that diversity in our staff and student population contributes to the quality of research and education at UM, and strive to enable this through inclusive policies and innovative projects led by teams of staff and students. We encourage you to apply for this position.
